The structure of Gd2Co4Si2 (reduced formula GdCo2Si) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co centers with 9 geometric neighbors (2 Co, 1 Gd, 6 Si), Gd centers with 16 neighbors (10 Co, 6 Si), and Si centers with 10 neighbors (6 Co, 2 Gd, 2 Si). The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing among Co 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Co and Si polyhedra.
